AI-powered Form for Marketplace

Product
AI
2025
Context Challenge My Role Solution Outcome
Role: Product Owner Timeline: 2025
Context
As part of Decathlon’s circular economy strategy, a digital marketplace was created to allow users to resell sports equipment and apparel directly to other users. The initiative aimed to extend product lifecycles, reduce waste, and introduce a sustainable value stream within the Decathlon ecosystem.
Challenge
Create a marketplace experience that allowed users to:
  • Publish second-hand items quickly and easily
  • Reduce effort and friction during listing creation
  • Ensure clear, accurate product information and pricing
  • Encourage adoption through a fast and intuitive flow
The interface needed to minimize decision fatigue while maintaining trust and listing quality.
My Role
As Product Owner, I:
  • Defined the end-to-end marketplace experience
  • Designed flows for listing creation, publication, and management
  • Built the product logic and supporting business model
  • Led the development of an AI-assisted listing form
  • Defined automation logic for item recognition and pricing suggestions
  • Held regular alignment meetings with the Decathlon team
  • Collaborated with design, engineering, and business stakeholders
Solution
The marketplace experience was designed to make listing an item fast, intuitive, and flexible across web and mobile. A key feature was the AI-powered listing form, allowing users to create a listing in under one minute:
  • Item recognition via image upload
  • Automatic title and description generation
  • Suggested category and package size
  • AI-assisted price estimation
  • Option to review, edit, and publish instantly
This reduced friction, improved listing quality, and simplified the listing process for all users - not just first-time sellers.
Outcome
  • Enabled Decathlon to support its circular economy strategy through peer-to-peer resale
  • Reduced friction in listing creation, encouraging user participation
  • Improved listing quality and pricing consistency through AI assistance
  • Delivered a scalable marketplace foundation for sustainable commerce
  • Encouraged reuse and extended product lifecycle within the Decathlon ecosystem
